title: The Expert (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar spoken word cabaret 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan male vocal dry observational absurdist comedy stately warm
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, stately and measured]
I want to tell you about a man
Who spent forty years becoming the world's leading expert
On something

[Verse 1]
He began in 1974 with genuine enthusiasm
He read everything there was to read
By 1982 he had read most of it
By 1991 he was considered very knowledgeable indeed

He presented at conferences
They were well-attended in the early years
By 2003 there were fewer people at the conferences
By 2011 there were fewer conferences

[Pre-Chorus]
By 2014, he was the only person
Who was still actively interested
In this particular thing
He considered this to be a sign of dedication

[Chorus]
He is the world's leading expert
On something no one asks about anymore
He is the world's leading expert
On something that has quietly stopped mattering
At conferences of one he presents his findings
To a room of considerable expertise
He is the world's leading expert
He is the world's leading expert

[Verse 2]
His wife remains supportive
She asks questions at breakfast
Which he answers in considerable depth
She listens for what she considers an appropriate amount of time

His children have moved interstate
This is not connected

[Bridge - spoken, entirely at peace]
He was asked recently
What the second-leading expert thought
He considered this for a moment
And said he believed there wasn't one
He said this without any apparent feeling
It was a statement of fact
He is, by a considerable margin
The world's leading expert

[Chorus]
He is the world's leading expert
On something no one asks about anymore
He is the world's leading expert
On something that has quietly stopped mattering
At conferences of one he presents his findings
To a room of considerable expertise
He is the world's leading expert
He is the world's leading expert

[Outro - piano, single notes, satisfied]
He is currently writing a book
The publisher is very supportive
They asked when it would be ready
He said when it's ready
They said of course
He has not heard from them since
He considers this to be editorial patience
